taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 4-8(-20) cm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 8-14(-21.5) cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole 6-20 cm, crisped-hairy.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade cordate-reniform to reniform, not mottled (Simpson p. 204: reniform to cordate).

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): rhizomes horizontal and shallow, internodes 1-3.5 cm.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): the rhizome's leaves stand in pairs; read here as one node with its pair each year, as the western species (inferred).

traits.flower_colour.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 204, Asarum canadense: calyx three-parted, maroon and cup-shaped. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): flowers spring to early summer (March to July); April-May are the model estimate's main months (species-facts-2026-10-15).

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

generator.params.note: Western wild ginger's values (the same genus and habit): a creeping rhizome sends up a pair of long-stalked leaves at each node. Its leaf length comes from the flora's blade. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.15 m at 4 years in the open: leaves on stalks 6-20 cm (FNA vol. 3), within the model's usual 0.1-0.2 m. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after FNA vol. 3 and Simpson: hairy stalks, pale green with a reddish cast as iNaturalist photographs show them (observations 7864289, 117742491, 340807025); soft, dull green, kidney-shaped leaves (the western species' card).

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): surfaces adaxially appressed-hirsute, at least along main veins: stiff hairs pressed flat, which Harris and Harris call strigose.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): surfaces abaxially appressed-hirsute, usually sparsely so (strigose); read as half way between bare and strigose, so sparse.

traits.leaf_hairs_on_veins.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): surfaces adaxially appressed-hirsute, at least along main veins.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole 6-20 cm, crisped-hirsute: stiff hairs, curled (crisped). The plant has no stem above ground, so its hairs are drawn on its leaf stalks.

traits.leaf_ciliate.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Asarum canadense (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): marginal hairs perpendicular to margin or curved toward apex.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2654269), as no source read gives it.

traits.life_span.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2654269), as no source read gives it.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2654269), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2654269), as no source read gives it.
